theorems.name: Submission.setIntegral_blowUpMap_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (x : Rn N) (r : ℝ) (A : Set (Rn N)) (g : Rn N → ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ y in blowUpMap x r '' A, g y ∂μHE[n] = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in A, g (blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
